verdict.rationale: ChatGPT, including Codex and ChatGPT Work, is itself an AI agent and assistant, so it fills the MCP client role. All MCP evidence in the pack is client-side: configuring MCP servers in config.toml and adding Context7 to give ChatGPT access to tools. Nothing shows ChatGPT running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' subcommand or a first-party hosted MCP endpoint, so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
